segments.name: Retail
segments.description: Sells hard surface flooring, installation materials, tools and decorative accessories to homeowners and professionals through warehouse-format stores and its website.
segments.evidence: The Company concluded that the economic and operating characteristics of its one reportable segment, Retail, are similar across its retail operations

revenueModel.text: Homeowners, professional installers and commercial businesses pay for flooring, installation materials, tools and accessories bought in stores or online.
revenueModel.evidence: We estimate that retail sales during both fiscal 2025 and fiscal 2024 were approximately 50% from homeowners and 50% from Pros.
